headline: Conoil Pre-Tax Profit Surges Over 200% in First Nine Months
summary: Conoil Plc reported a pre-tax profit of N5.98 billion for the first nine months of 2026, marking a 218.9% increase compared to the same period in 2025.
why: Conoil is a prominent Nigerian petroleum marketing company operating in the downstream energy sector, reflecting commercial trends in domestic fuel distribution.

impacts.name: Conoil Plc
impacts.why: Substantial profit growth highlights robust underlying commercial performance for the firm.
